chunks.title: README.md
chunks.content:
# SRPBS BAL-140 ROI order evidence

This directory publishes a small, non-voxel audit derived from a local `ROITBL_BAL.mat`; the 47 MiB source MAT is deliberately excluded from Git.

- `MAP` is `91 x 109 x 91 x 140`.
- `ROI.id`, `NUM.all`, and the fourth `MAP` dimension agree on order 1..140.
- `ROI.name` and `LAB.all` agree and provide 140 unique ordered labels.
- Rows 1..137 are BSA parcels; rows 138..140 are `L.CB`, `R.CB`, and `VERM`.
- This closes the BAL vector-name/order gap, but it does **not** create a BAL-to-AAL90 crosswalk. BSA sulcal parcels require an explicit spatial-overlap mapping to AAL90 anatomical parcels, with many-to-many decisions reviewed.

Until that mapping or a common-atlas recomputation is completed, BAL140 FC must not be truncated, padded, or passed into the AAL90 transfer encoder.

chunks.title: SRPBS_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
# 固定 DS005713 encoder 的 SRPBS 大阪外部验证

> 预注册主要成功判据**未达到**。本结果是跨图谱近似外部验证，不是临床有效性证明。

chunks.title: SRPBS_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
## 主要结果

SRPBS 疼痛 43 人 vs 健康 29 人：固定 encoder AUC `0.370`，Raw FC AUC `0.316`，差值 `+0.054`；配对标签置换单侧 `p=0.2629`。

chunks.title: SRPBS_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
## 次要结果

疼痛 43 人 vs 全部无疼痛 39 人：固定 encoder AUC `0.408`，Raw FC AUC `0.346`。

chunks.title: SRPBS_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
## 方法边界

- DS005713 checkpoint、scaler、OA n62 训练集和分类器搜索范围在读取 SRPBS 结局前固定。
- SRPBS 仅用于一次推理；其 condition/VAS/SF-MPQ2 均未进入 encoder、特征选择或分类器拟合。
- BAL140 官方相关矩阵经概率 overlap 和相关矩阵投影近似为 AAL90；未获得 ROI 时序，不能视为共同图谱重算。
- 21 名官方左侧疼痛翻转者在 AAL90 层交换左右节点以恢复原生方向；官方方向另作敏感性分析。

chunks.title: SRPBS_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
## 结论限制

- BAL140 ROI time series were unavailable; AAL90 FC is a deterministic but lossy projection of official BAL correlations.
- The official left-pain image flip is approximately undone after AAL90 projection; atlas asymmetry prevents exact inversion.
- OA patient/control status is confounded with OA acquisition cohort and preprocessing provenance.
- SRPBS probabilities are not recalibrated on external labels; threshold metrics and Brier score therefore test transport as-is.
- This validates research discrimination only, not pain severity, diagnosis, or clinical utility.

chunks.title: TRANSFER_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
## Leakage audit

Every self-supervised encoder was fitted on its current outer-training subjects only. Subject-list hashes and zero-overlap checks are recorded in `transfer_results.json`; every outer-test probability is in `transfer_predictions.tsv`.

chunks.title: TRANSFER_REPORT.md
chunks.content:
## Interpretation limits

- The current OA endpoint is patient versus control, not neuropathic-pain severity or treatment trajectory.
- Patient/control status is perfectly confounded with study/cohort in this dataset.
- This is internal cross-validation, not independent disease/site/scanner validation.
- The pain-related ROI set is a hypothesis prior and must be interpreted only through the prespecified ablation.
- The reconstruction encoder is not MeTSK, contrastive learning, SCDA, or a clinical foundation model.
- Repeat-averaged OOF metrics are descriptive and do not quantify external-cohort uncertainty.
- No method may be selected post hoc from these parallel results without an untouched validation cohort.

chunks.title: README.md
chunks.content:
# 99人主分析 / 96人敏感性：真实嵌套分类比较

2026-09-08。用户要求执行已确认的临床分类阶段。本轮为开发性完整嵌套交叉验证，不是旧N82之后的新独立确认；预训练、技术smoke、实际临床比较分别保存。

chunks.title: README.md
chunks.content:
## 执行前确定的方法

主分析全部99人（Healthy53/Pain46），按类别分层；敏感性OSU/CIN96人（Healthy52/Pain44），按站点×类别分层。读取研究者已确认的实际外折文件，各5重复×5外折；内层3折，在外折训练部分内按对应策略分层。完全相同的外折、内折用于全部比较方法。

共13方法：nuisance-only、Raw FC、target-fold SSL；SRPBS、DS005713、ABIDE、ABIDE→SRPBS来源适配、DS005713→SRPBS来源适配这五种编码器，各比较固定表示和临床训练折内重构适配。主要预先关注固定DS005713相对Raw及nuisance，其他既定路线全部保留，不挑最高AUC替代主要问题。

已有5份来源编码器只读复用。目标SSL30 epoch、目标适配5 epoch；latent32、hidden64、batch32、lr0.001、seed20260908（按折确定性偏移）。每个内层训练子集重新拟合SSL/适配；内层验证影像不参加重构。标准化、ANOVA选择、缺失填补与类别编码也只在相应训练部分拟合。不能用旧smoke的外折表示生成方式冒充完整嵌套。

分类器为balanced L2 logistic、liblinear、max_iter5000；C候选0.1/1/10，Raw边数16/32/64/128，表示维数8/16/32，按内折平均ROC-AUC选参，完全相同得分按既定列表顺序取首个。阈值固定0.5，不在测试上调阈值、不反转低于0.5的AUC。nuisance使用年龄、平均FD、censor比例、性别、站点、protocol、预处理策略；类别水平从训练部分学习，未知水平忽略。此对照用于混杂检查，不等于影像路径已经残差化消除混杂。

chunks.title: README.md
chunks.content:
## 结果与统计口径

两队列共650个模型外折，完整覆盖应为12,675条OOF记录。每人每方法每重复恰1条测试概率。报告每重复ROC-AUC、AP（不是梯形PR面积）、Brier、balanced accuracy、灵敏度、特异度及重复间描述性标准差。

2000次按类别分层的受试者配对bootstrap，对每次重采样内的5重复AUC求平均，保留同一人的全部重复预测；给出AUC以及相对Raw/nuisance差值的条件95%区间。该区间固定已训练的OOF预测，不重拟合模型，不包含完整训练不确定性，也未校正多重比较。ROC/PR曲线、5区间校准和站点/性别/处理策略分组使用每人平均OOF概率，属于描述性输出；小于10人或单类别组明确标注。

完整嵌套标签置换检验本轮未运行；不据条件区间宣称确认性显著性。VAS定义、独立队列验证与全嵌套置换仍是后续事项，G15不能因一次运行完成就自动等同于临床有效性成立。

chunks.content:
## 可复核实现与位置

- 代码：仓库`src/oa_rebuild/clinical_classification.py`、`scripts/run_clinical_classification.py`、`tests/test_clinical_classification.py`。
- 启动：本目录`launch.ps1`，隐藏窗口后台进程，输出位于`repository-local/tmp/clinical-classification-20260908/`；日志为同级`clinical-classification-20260908.stdout.log`及`.stderr.log`。
- `status.json`保存进度/错误；`run_config.json`记录预算和口径；每个外折保存预测、内外层拟合ID审计、分类器和临床适配检查点。仅运行全部完成才有根`summary.json`。
- 原始影像、来源包、旧实验、QC结论不改；逐人预测/审计与模型权重仅本地保存，不上传Git。

实现依据：[scikit-learn 嵌套CV](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/auto_examples/model_selection/plot_nested_cross_validation_iris.html)、[训练/测试隔离](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/common_pitfalls.html)、[指标定义](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/model_evaluation.html)。这些文档指导实现，不是本项目结果的验证证据。
